verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The workflow gives coverage-engine-run and coverage-engine-merge the same rust-cache shared-key and removes the job-scoped key input, matching the intended cross-job namespace. The regression tests inspect the actual top-level job bodies and rust-cache steps, require a present and equal shared-key, and reject reintroduction of key; the targeted two-test class passes at the PR head. Findings remain unchanged from round 2, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
